events.title: Vast changes incoming
events.description: On October 20, Omniscient announced that big changes will be made to Hack Forums in the upcoming week. Members should expect the website to be offline frequently, either as closed or returning a 403 error.

events.title: Welcome to MyBB 1.8x
events.description: Hack Forums has been upgraded to MyBB 1.8x, opening the opportunity for more custom features. New features include the ability to add a poll to a thread within 12 hours of posting and an edit reason field. The forum is still under heavy development and will take 1-2 weeks to stabilize.

events.title: Thread EDIT restriction removed
events.description: Omniscient lifted the previous restriction on the thread EDIT feature, which had limited members from editing threads older than a set number of days. The restriction was originally introduced to combat thread edit abuse.

events.title: Hack Forums IM Deleted
events.description: Omniscient deleted the Hack Forums IM service (the XMPP service designed for instant communication between HF members). No specific reason was given, though the service was rarely used. The newly launched public hacker.im service will continue to exist.

events.title: Forum Tabs Deleted
events.description: Omniscient removed the forum tabs from HF, stating they will not return. He has better ideas for index and forum navigation that will be mobile friendly and modern.

events.title: Purple HF Theme Deleted
events.description: The Purple Theme option has been removed. Omniscient has expressed a liking for iHydra's widely used 'Flat Darkness' theme.

events.title: UB3R Support and Meme Shit Meme sections Deleted
events.description: The UB3R Support and Meme Shit Meme sections have been deleted as part of Omniscient's HF cleanup.

events.title: All Non-Essential Moderators Removed
events.description: All non-essential moderators were removed, including (sub)forum moderators and site groups with special permissions like the Mentors group. Omniscient said 'We need a clean slate on a lot of HF' and will consider new moderators going forward.

events.title: HF Writers Group and Wiki Deleted
events.description: Omniscient deleted the HF Writers group along with the HF Wiki. The HF News team will continue to publish weekly editions assuming Omniscient permits it.

events.title: Mentor site group deleted
events.description: Omniscient deleted the Mentor site group. No specific reason was given.

events.title: Group changes.
events.description: Dαniel is now a leader of Eclipse. Mentors group has been disabled. Sheep Gang has been rebranded to Terminal. TopKekeroni is now a leader of Transcendence. Writers group has been disabled.

events.title: Bans
events.description: Linux™ was banned for reputation abuse, pending closure.

events.title: Account closures
events.description: Vana was closed for a post in the thread edit restriction announcement.

events.title: Awards
events.description: imscheurkie received the Grammar Nazi award; Steve received the Sticky Man award for thread tid=5735996.
